alias_recurrence.definition: Most frequently observed name per peer id, from inventory reconstruction; alias recurrence is not session or context continuity.

expanded_dispatch.definition: Preceding control-sender asks and notifications (events and resolved notify traces), plus all job-state events naming an assigned executor; not proof of causal dispatch.

peer_sender_repeats.null_definition: Within each sender, iid draws from observed recipient frequencies: sum p_i squared; weighted by n_sender-1.

peer_to_peer.path_warning: Distinct retained paths can be worktrees of one repository; not a cross-repository classification.
